project: MSF Companion — Tower Planner Ability-Aware Scoring
description: Upgrade the tower planner solver from pure trait-filter + power × safety_margin to a composite score that also considers faction synergy, opponent ability counters, and role balance. A team labeled 'Strong pick' should actually be a strong pick. Triggered by a real loss on WAR TOWER (OMEGA) cell 3 where the solver returned +56% margin / 'Strong pick' and the user lost twice in a row.

userStories.title: Faction-passive map constant
userStories.description: As the solver, I need a curated map of faction passives (trait → minimum members for activation) so faction-synergy scoring has data to work with.
acceptanceCriteria: New file src/lib/tower-scoring-data.ts exports FACTION_PASSIVES: Record<string, { trait: string; minMembers: number; description: string }>
Includes at least 12 entries (Asgardian, Avenger, X-Men, Inhuman, A-Force, Wakandan, Hand, Defenders, Symbiote, Black Order, Brotherhood, Mercs for Money)

Each entry has a one-line human description used later in the 'Why this team?' breakdown

userStories.notes: Implemented in src/lib/tower-scoring-data.ts with 12 faction entries (Asgardian, Avenger, X-Men, Inhuman, A-Force, Wakandan, Hand, Defender, Symbiote, Black Order, Brotherhood, Mercs for Money). No canonical trait enum exists in src/lib/characters (no such directory); used MSF-conventional human-readable trait strings (matches 'X-Men' / 'Mutant' style seen in existing room tests). userStories.title: factionSynergyScore pure function
userStories.description: As the solver, I need a pure function that scores a team 0–100 on faction synergy so it can be blended into the composite score.
acceptanceCriteria: New file src/lib/tower-scoring.ts exports factionSynergyScore(team: Character[], factionPassives: FactionPassiveMap): number
Returns 0 when no passive activates, scales up when one passive activates with exactly minMembers, peaks at 100 when ≥2 passives activate or one passive has all 5 members
Pure: no IO, no side effects
Unit tests in src/lib/__tests__/tower-scoring.test.ts cover: empty team, no synergy, exactly-threshold synergy, full-team synergy, multi-passive overlap
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in src/lib/tower-scoring.ts. Score = sum of per-activated-passive scores, where each activated passive contributes 50 + (count - minMembers)/(5 - minMembers) * 50 (capped at 100 per passive). Multi-passive overlap saturates at 100. Tests co-located at src/lib/tower-scoring.test.ts (not __tests__/) to match existing repo pattern (tower-solver.test.ts etc.). 8/8 tests pass; typecheck + ESLint clean.

userStories.title: Opponent ability-tag extractor with cache
userStories.description: As the solver, I need ability tags for every opponent unit so the counter-score can reward our characters that counter those tags.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/tower-ability-tags.ts exports extractAbilityTags(characterIds: string[]): Promise<Record<string, string[]>>
Uses existing getCharacterAbilities helper (grep for it under src/lib) — do not re-implement the API call

Heuristic tagger maps ability free-text to a fixed tag vocabulary including at least: revive, heal, bleed, disrupted, slow, blind, offense_down, defense_down, stun, ability_block, dispel, taunt, counter_attack, immune_to_bleed, heal_block, revive_block
In-memory + localStorage cache keyed by character id + ability hash; cache invalidates when ability hash changes
Unit tests cover at least 3 known characters with expected tags
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in src/lib/tower-ability-tags.ts. Note: PRD AC referenced an existing `getCharacterAbilities` helper but no such helper exists under src/lib (verified by grep). Used the canonical low-level `msfApiFetch` directly (same pattern as tower-enemy-fetcher.ts and upgrade-calculator.ts) hitting `/game/v1/characters/{id}?charInfo=full&abilityKits=full`. Heuristic tagger emits all 16 vocabulary tags; specific-qualifier patterns (immune_to_bleed, heal_block, revive_block) checked before their broader siblings. Cache: in-memory Map + localStorage (key tower-ability-tags-cache-v1), invalidated when meta.hashes.chars changes (mirrors tower-enemy-fetcher). 7/7 tests pass in src/lib/tower-ability-tags.test.ts; typecheck + ESLint clean.

userStories.title: counterScore pure function + counter map
userStories.description: As the solver, I need a pure function that scores a team 0–100 on how well its ability kit counters the opponent's ability kit.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/tower-scoring-data.ts exports COUNTER_MAP: Record<string, { counteredBy: string[]; weight: number }> with at least 12 entries covering revive, heal, bleed, disrupted, slow, blind, offense_down, defense_down, stun, ability_block, taunt, dispel
src/lib/tower-scoring.ts exports counterScore(teamTags: Record<string, string[]>, opponentTags: string[]): number returning 0–100
Score scales with weighted matches: each opponent tag matched by ≥1 team character contributes its weight; saturates at 100
Pure: no IO
Unit tests cover: no opponent tags → 0, full counter coverage → 100, partial coverage → intermediate, no team coverage of strong opp kit → low
Tests pass

userStories.title: roleBalanceScore pure function
userStories.description: As the solver, I need a small bonus for teams with healer + tank + ≥2 damage so a balanced kit beats a pure-DPS stack when other scores are equal.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/tower-scoring.ts exports roleBalanceScore(teamTags: Record<string, string[]>): number returning 0–100
Roles inferred from tag presence: healer (heal), tank (taunt OR defense_up), disruptor (ability_block OR stun OR disrupted), damage (default for any character without healer/tank tags)
Returns 100 when team has ≥1 healer, ≥1 tank or disruptor, ≥2 damage; scales down proportionally
Pure: no IO
Unit tests cover: all-damage team, healer-only team, balanced team, full-tank team
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Blend composite score into solveTowerAllocation
userStories.description: As a commander, I want the tower planner to pick the team with the highest composite score (not just highest power) among teams that pass the safety-margin gate.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/tower-solver.ts uses composite = 0.45*powerMargin + 0.20*factionSynergy + 0.25*counter + 0.10*roleBalance
Weights live as exported constants in src/lib/tower-scoring.ts (TOWER_SCORING_WEIGHTS) so they can be tuned
Eligibility filter and safety-margin gate remain unchanged — composite only re-ranks teams that already pass the gate
powerMarginScore normalized 0–100: 0 at margin 0%, 100 at margin ≥ 50% over safety threshold
Opponent ability tags fetched once per /api/tower/solve request and passed into the solver
Existing tower-solver unit tests still pass
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Composite-aware confidence labels + reason breakdown
